A1.justification: Local reading tools stalled without returning content from the PDF skill or either PDF. The documents, including their appendices, could not be inspected. This is an access failure, not evidence that material is missing from either version.

before.justification: The contents of v2.pdf were unavailable for inspection, so original empirical results could not be verified.

after.justification: The contents of v3.pdf were unavailable for inspection, so original empirical results could not be verified.

M1.justification: Neither version's method description could be read; changes to the algorithm, model, or procedure cannot be determined.

E1.justification: Training and evaluation coverage could not be inspected, preventing comparison of datasets, tasks, and test scenarios.

E2.justification: Reported comparisons were inaccessible, so baseline participation could not be matched across versions.

E3.justification: Experimental settings and evaluation protocols could not be read or compared.

E4.justification: The main text and appendices were inaccessible, preventing assessment of changes to ablations, robustness tests, or supplementary analyses.

E5.justification: Run counts, seeds, uncertainty estimates, and statistical reporting could not be inspected.

E6.justification: Results passages, tables, and figures could not be read, so numerical values and qualitative findings could not be compared under matched conditions.

T1.justification: Definitions, assumptions, derivations, and proofs could not be inspected in either version.

C1.justification: The abstracts, introductions, and conclusions were inaccessible, preventing comparison of core claims and contributions.

C2.justification: Interpretations, mechanism explanations, applicability boundaries, and limitations could not be read.

D1.justification: Implementation and reproducibility disclosures could not be inspected, including any details in the appendices.

R1.justification: Related-work discussions and reference lists were inaccessible, so citation and research-positioning changes could not be determined.

P1.justification: No document text was returned, preventing assessment of language editing, terminology, or structural changes.

P2.justification: No pages could be visually inspected, preventing comparison of figures, tables, captions, and layout.

improvement.justification: Neither PDF could be inspected because local reading tools stalled. Without before-and-after document evidence, no reliable judgment about overall quality improvement or deterioration is possible.
